about: v7 reception set (written 27 Oct 2026, before any RECEPTION result): 8 types x 5 from the brief's examples. Rule (fixed now): RECEPTION=1 kept if judge passes >= RECEPTION=0 passes + 6, the claim checker's unsupported rate is not higher and judge grounding is not lower. Also reported: citation precision / recall, sources used, evidence hit@5 (expect_evidence: any of the top 5 evidence units matches one condition). The judge's pass needs: sources named, critics and audiences kept apart, sample sizes where it generalises.
